title: NIST WebBook: potassium chloride is ClK, molecular weight 74.551 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists potassium chloride as ClK, molecular weight 74.551 amu, CAS 7447-40-7.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for potassium chloride, CAS Registry Number 7447-40-7, lists molecular formula ClK and molecular weight 74.551 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 73.93255936 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/ClH.K/h1H;/q;+1/p-1. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
